ei.title: The Life and Achievements of Bessie Smith, the Empress of the Blues

fullPassage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."

She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and ④<u>is</u> still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 모두 어법상 적절하나, 본 문제는 기출 스타일 확인용. 정답은 ①에 대한 정밀 분석.
det.analysis:
❌ ① was born: '태어났다'는 수동태 과거 — 적절.
❌ ② to gain: be unable to + 동사원형 — 적절.
❌ ③ which: Down Hearted Blues를 선행사로 받는 주격 관계대명사(계속적 용법) — 적절.
✅ ④ is: 문장 구조 'Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered'에서 주어 Bessie는 단수이므로 is 맞음 — 실제로 적절. (본 문항은 분석 교체 필요)
